METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

4. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.

7. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.

8. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.

9. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

10. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

12. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Forging.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Metalwork related businesses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Heat treatment of steel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Centre La and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Project 1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
